title: Pool protocol v1 message: offer_reject (router -> coordinator)
description: Phase 1 of two-phase dispatch (D-D2): the router declines the offered job. The coordinator moves the offer to the next candidate WITHOUT transferring the body. A race (e.g. no_slot) is normal and not an error (D-D3).

job_id.description: Job id from the work_offer being rejected.

reason.description: model_gone: model no longer loaded on this router; ctx_insufficient: real context below est_ctx_needed; no_slot: no free slot; busy: router intentionally busy; evicted: model was evicted between offer and decision; other: anything else.

detail.description: Optional short, non-sensitive reason text. Must NEVER include prompt/response content (anti-memory, D-I1); capped at 200 chars.
